dedupe_keys.name: lyon fedder mobarry magnetosphere model part of the coupled magnetosphere ionosphere thermosphere cmit model

description: LFM models the interaction between the solar wind and magnetosphere using magnetohydrodynamics. The documented CMIT configuration couples LFM and MIX electrodynamics with the TIE-GCM upper-atmosphere model. The resource is documented by Rice; JHU APL; National Science Foundation. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere, Global Ionosphere, Thermosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The source says its ring-current component has not been released or tested for runs on request. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
